text.title: Wyeth: expanding Enbrel production capacity (Ireland plant), 2006 article
text.decision: How to expand Enbrel production capacity quickly, including a new plant in Ireland
text.r_who: People closest to the knowledge; some responsibilities pushed down to the business units
text.r_note: Make a proposal or offer alternatives; individual names are not given
text.a_note: Kept veto power over many important proposals; a veto comes with an alternative or goes to the Decide role
text.p_note: Carries out the plan; responsibility for execution rested firmly with it
text.i_note: Gave input to the Enbrel team before the decisions; the recommender weighs it but need not follow it
text.d_who: Cavan Redmond, executive vice president and general manager of the biotech division
text.d_note: Took many Enbrel decisions after he and his team gathered input from other managers
text.conflict: Veto holder offers an alternative or escalates to the person with the D
text.outcome: Roles assigned for Enbrel decisions; the article gives no date, result or confirmation that the Irish plant was approved
